liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Rock Steady**: rare: 4 archived performances [6]
- **enocre break**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]

## The recordings

- **soulive2011-08-13** (recommended): source not stated; 13 songs; 99 min [1]
- **soulive2011-08-13.akg483.flac24**: source not stated; 12 songs; 99 min [2]. Said about its sound: This is a 24-bit recording, not intended for burning to CD [2]
- **soulive2011-08-13.akg483.flac16**: source not stated; 12 songs; 99 min [3]
- **soulive2011-08-13.Schoeps_mk41_24bit**: source not stated; 12 songs; 100 min [4]

## Around the show

- Ryan Zoidis played baritone and tenor sax; Sam Kininger played tenor and alto sax; Jennifer Hartswick joined on trumpet and/or vocals [2]
- Chali 2na guested on vocals; Adam Deitch, Skerik, Dominic Lalli and a percussionist also sat in [2]
- Ryan Zoidis played baritone and tenor sax; Sam Kininger tenor and alto; Jennifer Hartswick sat in on trumpet and/or vocals; Chali 2na on vocals [3]
- The microphones were placed about 100 feet from the stage, in the DFC position [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **soulive2011-08-13**: taped by Rob Clarke; transferred by Rob Clarke; source: Neumann KM184> V2> R44 [1]. Also: Rob Clarke recorded and transferred it using Neumann km184 mics, a V2, and a Sony PCM-M10 recorder [1]
- **soulive2011-08-13.akg483.flac24**: taped by corey the groundhog (china_c_a_tATyahooDOTcom); transferred by groundhog; source: akg 483 > V2 > r-44 > WAV (24/96k) [2]
- **soulive2011-08-13.akg483.flac16**: taped by corey the groundhog (china_c_a_tATyahooDOTcom); transferred by groundhog; source: akg 483 > V2 > r-44 > WAV (24/96k) [3]. Also: Transfer went through Audacity to 44.1k WAV, then xACT to FLAC8 [3]
- **soulive2011-08-13.Schoeps_mk41_24bit**: taped by Andy Murray; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Schoeps MK41>KC5>CMC6>Sonosax SX-M2>Apogee Mini-me(aes out,24bit/96khz)>COAX>Edirol R-44 [4]. Also: Capture was 24-bit/96kHz via AES out and coax into the recorder [4]
